title: Weightlifter · Level 3: Lift 150 g fastest, energy counted
brief: Lift a 140 to 160 g payload (not told to the program) from the lower stop (-30 deg) to +45 deg (within 3 deg) and hold it there 2 s without stalling (a stall counts from the arm leaving its stop: homing against the stop is free). You choose the gear (1, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 or 1/5) in Configure robot. Per run: 50 for a good lift + 35 x min(1, 0.30 s / t) + 15 x min(1, E_ref / E), E the motor's electrical energy over the same window as t, E_ref the reference lift's at 5:1. Pass: a mean of 60 and at least 8 good lifts.

score.run: if(good, round(50 + 35 * min(1, par / liftS) + 15 * min(1, eRef / max(liftJ, 0.001)), 1), 0)
